Container.Name: HMG-Calendar
Container.Overview: Unified media calendar dashboard for Radarr and Sonarr. HMG Calendar pulls upcoming movie release dates and TV air dates over your internal Docker network and displays them in a dark FullCalendar interface.

Config.Name: Web UI Port
Config.Description: Container web port for HMG Calendar. Point Nginx Proxy Manager to this port.

Config.Name: Radarr URL
Config.Description: Internal Docker URL for Radarr. Use http://172.18.0.10:7878 if container DNS does not resolve.

Config.Name: Radarr API Key
Config.Description: Radarr API key from Settings > General > Security.

Config.Name: Sonarr URL
Config.Description: Internal Docker URL for Sonarr. Use http://172.18.0.12:8989 if container DNS does not resolve.

Config.Name: Sonarr API Key
Config.Description: Sonarr API key from Settings > General > Security.

Config.Name: Application Port
Config.Description: Internal application port. Leave this at 3000 unless you also change the port mapping.
